name: Md Nafisul Islam
headline: AI driven iOS | Swift | SwiftUI | Django | Flutter | React Native
about: iOS Mobile App Developer with a solid skill set in iOS framework, Swift, Objective-C, Flutter, and more. Expertise lies in developing mobile applications, utilizing various technologies and frameworks. With a keen eye for detail and a strong understanding of industry best practices, adept at delivering high-quality, user-friendly, and efficient software solutions. A proactive problem solver, constantly seeking opportunities to enhance my skills and stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in mobile development.

experience.title: Senior iOS Engineer
highlights: Integrated an on-device AI model to detect and blur sensitive or inappropriate content within images dynamically.
Implemented DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) to securely resolve domain names, enabling content filtering and preventing access to harmful or unwanted websites.
Leveraged Swift Concurrency to parallelize image processing tasks and optimized real-time mask rendering over images to reduce latency.
Rewrote the iOS and macOS app from React Native to native SwiftUI.
Implemented the Family Controls API to block apps or categories and showed users their app usage through graphs.
Implemented a full habit tracker feature.

experience.title: Mobile App Team Lead
highlights: Migrated an existing UIKit codebase to modern SwiftUI while shipping new features, integrating SwiftUI with legacy UIKit components.
Led the iOS app redesign (flight search, hotel search, holiday planning), increasing app downloads by 15% and boosting ticket sales by 32%.
Helped move the app from travel-only to a lifestyle platform (mobile recharge, utility bill payment, shopping), increasing app downloads by 70% over 3 months.
Led a team of developers, coordinated with product managers and designers, conducted code reviews, and mentored junior developers.
Developed the ShareTrip Flight SDK so other apps can embed flight booking.
Designed and implemented STPay core features: Add Money, Send Money, Request Money, and Merchant Payment.
Redesigned STPay login and registration so users can verify their account with their National ID within minutes.
Built the STPay SDK, allowing third-party developers to integrate STPay's financial services into their own apps.

experience.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Rewrote core elements of Ridmik Keyboard to improve typing speed and memory efficiency, resolving performance complaints and improving user reviews.
Implemented contextual word suggestions, increasing app impressions by 3% (1M) and downloads by 1% (267K) within 3 months.
Introduced and refined keyboard features such as emojis, GIFs, and stickers.
Developed paid custom themes, creating a new revenue stream for the app.
Redesigned the Boitoi app with UI/UX designers and implemented ebook streaming so users can read without downloading.
Developed the Comic Books feature and a bridge between native Swift code and JavaScript-based web views.

experience.title: Team Lead of Map Team & Apps Division
Software Engineer
highlights: Developed the Dingi Life iOS app: enhanced map for Bangladesh, city bus service, live traffic, address search, and voice navigation.
Forked Mapbox (open source) to develop the DingiMap SDK for iOS, Android, and JavaScript.
